name: Komanda Church Massacre
detail: ADF/ISCAP fighters attacked a night vigil at Saint Anuarite Catholic church in Komanda, Ituri, killing 38-43 civilians by gun and machete — linked by MONUSCO to reprisals for the Operation Shujaa strike on ADF's Madina camp.

name: Operation Shujaa Strikes on Madina Camp
detail: Joint UPDF-FARDC Operation Shujaa intensified pressure on ISCAP's largest forest encampment, 'Madina,' in Mambasa territory, Ituri — the offensive cited by ADF as provocation for its July 2025 reprisal massacres.

name: FARDC Drone Strike Kills M23 Spokesman
detail: A Congolese army drone strike near Rubaya killed Willy Ngoma, M23's veteran military spokesman, during the Feb 2026 Masisi counteroffensive — the highest-profile M23 loss of the campaign.

name: FARDC-Wazalendo Retake Masisi Villages
detail: Congolese army and Wazalendo militia forces captured Miruta, Ngololo and the Katoyi group center southwest of Rubaya after four days of fighting, the opening phase of the Feb 2026 Masisi offensive.

name: Wazalendo-M23 Clashes Near Kavumu Airport
detail: Pro-government Wazalendo fighters clashed with M23 forces north of Bukavu near Kavumu airport, South Kivu, despite the standing ceasefire verification mechanism.
